sections.text: Light God of the Guard XL

[Effects]
Physical and magic damage taken reduces by S+ - XL based on the light elemental defense value.
Nullifies Stun.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.
When an Ability that causes Stun is used against you.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate against Dark enemies increases to L.
